name: @mashbean/pocket-polis
description: Pocket Polis (口袋審議): a lightweight Polis, designed and deployable in one step by AI agents — a complete wikisurvey round on a single Cloudflare Worker, no server to host

scripts.deploy:production: node scripts/ensure-queue.mjs production && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run deploy:dry

ASSETS.description: Static participant, report and admin pages.

CONVERSATION.description: One SQLite Durable Object per conversation (statements, votes, clustering).

NEURON_COORDINATOR.description: Durable Object coordinating background sensemaking jobs.

SENSEMAKING_QUEUE.description: Queue for background clustering and summaries; created on first deploy.

AI.description: Workers AI binding used for optional summaries.

MCP_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Optional secret: enables private enumeration and global administration over MCP. Leave empty unless you operate MCP clients.
